hooks.command:
cd "D:/projects/astro-consolidated-app" || exit 0
porcelain=$(git status --porcelain)
if [ -z "$porcelain" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push] No changes."}'; exit 0; fi
paths=$(echo "$porcelain" | cut -c4-)
if echo "$paths" | grep -iqE '(^|/)\.env($|\.)|\.pem$|\.key$|\.p12$|credentials|secrets'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push] ABORTED — sensitive file pattern detected. Commit manually."}'; exit 0; fi
big=$(echo "$paths" | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ $(wc -c < "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) -gt 52428800 ] && echo "$f"; done | head -1)
if [ -n "$big" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push] ABORTED — file >50MB: %s"}\n' "$big"; exit 0; fi
branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push] ABORTED — detached HEAD."}'; exit 0; fi
git add -A >/dev/null
count=$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
ts=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
git commit -m "auto: session update [$ts] ($count files)" >/dev/null 2>&1
if GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push origin "$branch" >/tmp/autopush_aca.log 2>&1; then
  printf '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push astro-consolidated-app] Pushed %s files to %s at %s"}\n' "$count" "$branch" "$ts"
else
  tail_msg=$(tail -3 /tmp/autopush_aca.log | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"' | cut -c1-200)
  printf '{"systemMessage":"[auto-push astro-consolidated-app] PUSH FAILED: %s"}\n' "$tail_msg"
fi
